items.name: hero-plain
items.title: Hero: Plain
items.description: Left-aligned hero with a label, a specific headline, two buttons and three short proof points. Written copy, no lorem ipsum.

items.name: hero-split
items.title: Hero: Split
items.description: Headline and one button on the left, a small product picture on the right drawn with plain elements, so it looks finished before you have a screenshot.

items.name: hero-signup
items.title: Hero: Signup
items.description: Centred headline with one highlighted phrase and an accessible email form, ready to connect to your email tool.

items.name: burst-depth
items.title: Burst: Depth
items.description: A burst of light rising from the bottom edge, in 3D. The whole burst turns gently towards the pointer. Written copy, theme colors, one file.

items.name: burst-drift
items.title: Burst: Drift
items.description: A 3D burst of light that drifts on its own; rays bend away from the pointer. Written copy, theme colors, one file.

items.name: burst-flare
items.title: Burst: Flare
items.description: A 3D burst turned inside out: bright dots near the centre, tails streaking outwards. Written copy, theme colors, one file.

items.name: burst-part
items.title: Burst: Part
items.description: Light streaks that step aside and stretch as the pointer passes, like parting a curtain of light. Written copy, theme colors, one file.

items.name: burst-fan
items.title: Burst: Fan
items.description: A flat fan of light rays, some dashed and moving, that curve away from the pointer. Written copy, theme colors, one file.
